title: The Forest House
description:
The Forest House is an Oasis located between the urban and countryside. Country style and has been adapted to offer comfort, tranquility and an ecological environment on 4.5-acre lot surrounded by trees and nature, it has an area to make firepit, a natural stream and path for walking within the same property for those who like activity abroad without going any further.

Just 3 minutes from Interstate 40-E, 4 min from lake, 15 min from the Airport and 25 min from downtown Nashville.
